message.description: Pecks and removes ripening fruit; a major cherry bird pest.

node.name: American Robin
node.protected_note: Protected by the Migratory Bird Treaty Act: lethal control needs a USFWS depredation permit. Lead with netting, scare devices and habitat.

thresholds.name: PAT-00010
thresholds.recommended_methods: MBTA-protected: netting, rotated scare devices, raptor perches and kestrel boxes, prompt harvest. Lethal control only under a USFWS depredation permit.
